mentions.name: Knotend
mentions.description: A grid-based flowchart editor where, instead of a freeform canvas, all nodes are uniform-sized and sit in grid cells, with spreadsheet-style keyboard navigation. It aims to make editing flowcharts much faster through keyboard-centric editing and autolayout.
mentions.problem: Editing flowcharts is slow; the tool makes it faster via keyboard-centric interaction and autolayout.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A new kind of grid-based flowchart editor. The design is to have a grid instead of a canvas, and all nodes are the same size and sit in a cell. On top of that, there’s keyboard navigation kind of like a spreadsheet.

The idea is to make editing flowcharts way faster by being keyboard centric and having autolayout.

https://www.knotend.com
